items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: I went to play with him in Alexander... I got Bourne. Bourne was the weakest man in the island band, but he could make out.

ctx.x: I asked you who this Bourne was. That's not Harrison Bourne.
That's been about 24 years ago, ain't it? Is that Harrison Bourne? Huh? Is that Harrison Bourne, you mean? Harrison? Bourne. Uh, Julius Bourne. Julius Bourne. Julius Bourne.
